highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148, with a reworked singleton lifecycle.
highlights_body: It adds variable font and color font palette support, animated WebP encoding, and zero-copy stream-to-data conversion. This is a breaking release for anyone still on the pre-v4 obsolete text/font APIs or Vulkan 1.0 hardware — check the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: Legacy paint/font text APIs promoted to compiler errors
breaking.body: Pre-v4 obsolete members on SKPaint and SKFont for reading/writing text and font state now fail to build instead of just warning. Move typeface, text size, and text-measurement calls onto SKFont/SKPaint's current APIs.

breaking.title: SKFont/SKPaint no longer resolve a lazy default typeface
breaking.body: new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you set a real typeface; new SKPaint().Typeface returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface and check IsEmpty instead of comparing to null.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default never return null
breaking.body: FromFamilyName now returns SKTypeface.Default on every platform (including Android) instead of null for an unknown family, and SKTypeface.Default is guaranteed non-null everywhere. Use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily for a strict null-on-not-found check.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and now throws on overflow
breaking.body: The long overload used to silently truncate offsets beyond int range; it is now [Obsolete] and throws OverflowException instead. Call Move(int) with an in-range offset.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a sub-1.1 instance/device causes the native process to abort instead of CreateVulkan returning null. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion, and fall back to raster on genuinely 1.0-only hardware.

breaking.title: Vulkan interop structs changed shape
breaking.body: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice (use fVkExtensions/fDeviceFeatures instead); GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo gained a new Components field, and GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, which lost value-equality.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now builds on Skia m148, rolling up multiple milestone bumps and rounds of upstream chrome bug-fix syncs since the 3.x line.

bullets.lead: Variable font and color font support
bullets.detail: Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, plus color font palette selection, so apps can render weight/width/palette-variable fonts directly.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream reads
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can now write animated WebP files, and SKStream.GetData() lets callers pull stream contents into an SKData without an intermediate copy.

bullets.lead: GPU draw-surface sampling and native asset coverage
bullets.detail: SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions, and Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native assets were added to the build matrix.

bullets.lead: Missing API wrappers and naming fixes
bullets.detail: Adds a proper HBColor struct plus a set of missing API wrappers and naming-convention corrections found while auditing the binding surface.

bullets.lead: Pixel access and finalizer crashes corrected
bullets.detail: SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the right axis for offsets, and a finalizer ordering crash when SKPathBuilder is collected before its SKPath is fixed.

bullets.lead: Default-typeface resolution moved to managed code
bullets.detail: Resolving the default typeface now happens in the managed layer instead of relying on a native path that could fail on newer Android API levels.
Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch, and a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers.

Reworks how SkiaSharp's native singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup.
Updates expat to 2.8.1, harfbuzz to 14.2.0, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Drove the Skia m132/m147 bumps, variable font support, the singleton lifecycle rework, the SKPath finalizer fix, the managed default-typeface fix, and several Uno Platform sample updates.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native assets support and PolySharp-based C# 13 support on legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Reduced the SkiaFiddle WASM application size by about 60%.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the Uno Platform link and description in the README.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch.

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The release candidate promoted the remaining legacy text/font obsoletes to compile errors, fixed the pixmap stride/offset bugs, and reworked the singleton lifecycle ahead of the stable v4 release.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 dropped native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten, added the HBColor struct and missing API wrappers, enabled TreatWarningsAsErrors across the binding, and refreshed zlib/freetype.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added SKStream.GetData(), animated WebP encoding, and fixed the SKPath/SKPathBuilder finalizer crash.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m147 bump, variable font and color font palette support, and updated native dependencies (libpng, libexpat).

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 gains variable font support and an HBColor value type alongside the harfbuzz 14.2.0 bundled update.
